reviews.text: This place has always given amazing service and the fact that the vet speaks Spanish is a MAJOR PLUS. My mom doesn't speak much English and to make her feel involved is as import to me as it is for our paw babies 🐾.

Just got back home from taking my dog Luna to get checked up for some skin issues. Both the receptionists and the Doctor were really great. They explained to me the issue, and gave me a clear and detailed plan to get my dog feeling well again. Thank you guys!

I have been bringing my dog to this clinic for about 10 years, which is why this experience was extremely disappointing.

My dog, Canelo, has epilepsy and has been taking phenobarbital (16.2 mg) for years. I went in because I only needed a refill of his medication and was willing to do the liver blood test required to renew it.

Instead, I was presented with a list of services totaling close to $600. I explained that I am currently not working and that my family has important expenses right now, including my daughter’s wedding this week. I clearly stated that I only needed the refill and the liver test.

When I declined the additional services, the staff member became upset, stood up, and slammed the door simply because I said I could not afford everything and only wanted those two services. Shortly after, the doctor came in with a dismissive attitude and told me that if I did not accept the full package, they would not do anything at all.

He refused to provide the refill, even though my dog depends on this medication for seizures. The appointment was ended without any help, and I was still charged for the visit.

I also requested my dog’s medical records at the front desk, and I was told they would be emailed to me within 24–48 hours. It has now been a week, and I still have not received anything.

After being a loyal client for a decade and spending thousands of dollars here, I left feeling disrespected and unsupported.

I have requested my dog’s medical records and will be taking my business elsewhere.

Thank you for your response.

I want to clarify that I did request blood work and a medication refill. What I declined was a package that included multiple additional services I did not request.

My focus has always been to continue my dog’s treatment responsibly, without being pressured into unnecessary services.

Thank you.

Want to say that this place was very understanding about the situation with my pet, They really hear you. The receptionist was kind  & the Dr. was very knowledgeable and also great with handling cats. Thank you for caring,  may my little guy rest well
They deleted a comment protecting one of their bad and disrespectful worker. This place should be ashamed of them selfs.

Dr Nolasco has been my doctor for 13 years , they are wonderful here I've never had an issue coming here , they helped me with my little girl so many times. The staff is wonderful especially Diane the front desk staff , thank you Valley animal hospital!!!

Excellent animal hospital. I’ve been taking my dogs there for the last 10 years. My boys love Dr.Nolasco and Dr. Katila. Very professional and friendly staff. They always offer excellent treatment for my boys and good care. I could never take them to a different vet.

I brought in a very sick female stray cat who had been living in my backyard for years. She had become part of our lives — gentle, trusting, and clearly at the end of her strength. I wanted to help her and do what was right, but this place completely shattered my trust.

From the moment we arrived, she was weak and moving slowly. Instead of being honest and telling us that the kindest, most humane option would be to let her go peacefully, they insisted on doing a long list of tests — over $700 worth — knowing full well she was on her last breath.

The next day, I called them to find out how the cat is doing and the doctor said she was very sick and recovery chances were extremely slim. Then came the question: Did I want them to put her to sleep? I told them I wanted to be there with her, and I also made it clear that I was very unhappy with how the situation had been handled. The receptionist quoted me $300 for euthanasia, and I reluctantly agreed, even though I already felt taken advantage of.

When I arrived, I expressed again how wrong this felt — that they had used our love and emotions to squeeze out every dollar they could before admitting the truth. They guided me to a small room and told me to wait so I could be there with her. After several minutes, the doctor came in with a sad look and told me… she had already died.

No one called. No one checked in sooner. No one seemed to care.

Yes, they refunded the euthanasia fee — but that doesn’t undo what they did. My wife and I left heartbroken — not just from losing a sweet soul who trusted us, but from realizing how cold and unethical this place truly is.

They took advantage of compassion, made money off a dying animal, and then delivered the news like it was nothing.
I will never take another animal here. They showed no honesty, no empathy, and no integrity.
